description: The messages in one guest conversation — body, direction (isIncoming), channel/email/SMS type, send status and timestamps. By default only sent messages; set includeScheduledMessages to also see scheduled, paused or failed ones. Hostaway: GET /v1/conversations/{conversationId}/messages.

includeScheduledMessages.description: Also return scheduled / failed / paused messages.

offset.description: Records to skip from the start.

name: hostaway_list_conversation_messages
title: Read a conversation
